title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
summary: A father and his young son push a shopping cart south across an ash-covered America, after an unnamed disaster has killed almost everything. They scavenge for food and hide from other survivors, who are mostly dangerous.
readIf: you want a spare, devastating story about love between a parent and child in the worst of worlds.
skipIf: you want hope or explanation, since the book is relentlessly bleak and gives little backstory.

pairings.reason: Another quiet post-collapse novel, but one that looks for art, beauty and people who still care.
A more active and political story of travelling through a ruined America with a purpose.
